title: A Colony for the Protocol
author: Rosalind Zhou
blurb: Xanthe Reyes, an insurance investigator of impossible accidents, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. But when a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
